en: Once Upon a Time in Hollywood
orig: Once Upon a Time in Hollywood
ov: حدث ذات مرة في هوليوود (الإنجليزية: Once Upon a Time in Hollywood) هو فيلم دراما أمريكي عرض سنة 2019، الفيلم من كتابة وإخراج كوينتن تارانتينو، ومن بطولة نخبة من النجوم، من بينهم ليوناردو دي كابريو وبراد بيت وآل باتشينو ومارجوت روبي. عرض لأول مرة في مهرجان كان السينمائي عام 2019 وعرض في دور العرض بتاريخ 23 أغسطس 2019.
plotEn:
In February 1969, Hollywood actor Rick Dalton, a former Western TV star, copes with a fading career, as his most recent roles are guest appearances as TV villains. Agent Marvin Schwarz explains how playing villains is ruining his career, and suggests he act in spaghetti Westerns in Italy.
Rick's best friend, stunt double, personal assistant, and driver Cliff Booth, struggles to find stunt work due to rumors that he murdered his wife. Rick is aware that young actress Sharon Tate and her husband, director Roman Polanski, have moved in next door. Rick longs to have them reignite his career.
Tate watches herself in The Wrecking Crew at a local film theater. Cliff gives hitchhiker Pussycat a ride to Spahn Ranch, a former Western film set where Cliff did stunt work.
Cliff checks on George Spahn, the ranch's nearly blind owner, seeking to make sure the hippies living there are not exploiting him. Cliff physically forces ranch hippie Clem to change his car tire after Clem knifes it.
While filming an episode for the TV series Lancer, Rick struggles to deliver his lines, causing him to have an emotional breakdown in his trailer. He later gives a powerful performance during his character's speech, impressing director Sam Wanamaker and his co-star Trudi, boosting his confidence.
Schwarz books Rick to star in a Sergio Corbucci spaghetti Western. Cliff accompanies Rick for the six-month shoot in Italy, where Rick films three additional films and marries Italian starlet Francesca Capucci. B
